intro.text: Beings of Roshar named for the things they gather around. There are said to be thousands of kinds, from the size of a thumbnail to bigger than buildings.

Fragments of the powers of creation that gained awareness through the influence of thinking beings on Roshar. They vary hugely in look and intelligence. A Nahel bond with a spren lets Knights Radiant Surgebind.

description.text: Lesser spren are said to be always present, though often unseen, and appear around their namesake. Even common kinds sometimes fail to show. All spren are very rare in Shinovar, and emotion spren are rare in crowds.

Rosharans call many beings spren, including Shards and Cognitive Shadows. Objects have Cognitive aspects, also called spren, that look like beads in Shadesmar and can be bribed with Stormlight; this is how Soulcasting works.
A few spren are one of a kind, such as the Nightwatcher, the Stormfather, the Sibling and the nine Unmade. Each has its own power, and their minds range from nearly human to animal-like.
Larger spren can change shape, copy faces and voices, and pick up small objects. Some Unkalaki, called alaii'iku, can see spren that do not show themselves.

items.text: True spren that cross into the Physical Realm can barely affect it. In Shadesmar most are human-sized and humanlike; in the Physical Realm they take smaller, simpler forms.
Most spren are lesser spren, also called subspren, and are not sapient. Some can speak, but talking with them rarely gets anywhere.
Sapient spren are called true spren. Each seems to stand for a higher idea, such as honor for honorspren or truth and lies for Cryptics.
Singers change form by taking a spren into their gemheart during a highstorm. Each form has its own shape and biology.
A Knight Radiant strengthens their bond by speaking Ideals. Once it is strong enough, the spren can become a Shardblade of any shape the Knight needs, and speak to them in their mind.
Ryshadium horses have evolved to draw a spren, most likely musicspren, which may explain their intelligence and strength.
Some unique spren can be bonded. Bondsmiths draw their powers from such bonds, and the Stormfather is one of three great Bondsmith spren. Some Unmade bond people too.
Greatshells use spren bonds to grow far larger than they otherwise could: an unknown spren in their gemhearts, and mandras, which lessen gravity. Skyeels bond mandras to fly without wings.
Each kind of Radiant spren has lesser "cousin" spren that form the Radiant's Shardplate once they swear enough Ideals.
Voidspren are made of Odium's essence. Lesser voidspren are not sapient but can bond singers to give them Regal forms.
Some voidspren are sapient. Unlike other true spren, they keep their minds in the Physical Realm without a bond. They usually look like small Shin people, coloured yellow or red.
The Unmade Sja-anat can corrupt lesser spren, which she calls Enlightening. Enlightened spren look misshapen, with parts painfully exaggerated.
Sja-anat can now Enlighten true spren too. They can still form Nahel bonds, and Enlightening does not force them to side with Odium.
Rural Vorin folk believe in malicious spren such as raspings, stormwhispers and, most feared, nightspren. Educated people think the Knights Radiant made these up long ago.
Vorin teaching calls the Dawnsingers spren sent by the Almighty to care for humanity, bringing gifts such as the Dawnchant. They turn out to be the ancient singers, not spren.
Folklore calls the Voidbringers evil spren with bodies of stone that eat human flesh. The tales draw on Odium's servants, and the truth comes out that the Voidbringers were humans.
